subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Gain and Phase Margins: Safety Buffers
description: A fast breakdown of Gain and Phase Margins: Safety Buffers for builders.

hook.text: A system right at the edge of instability works in theory but fails in practice. Margins provide safety.

buildup.text: Gain margin: how much you can increase gain before instability. Typically 6 dB or more is safe.

discovery.text: Phase margin: how much extra phase lag the system can tolerate. 45° to 60° is a common target.

twist.text: Component aging, temperature changes, and manufacturing tolerances all eat into margins — plan for it.

climax.text: Aerospace control systems demand large margins because failure means catastrophe.

punchline.text: Stability margins are engineering's insurance — never design to the edge.
